notes: First NL run 2026-11-03. Every entry source page was opened with WebFetch; search snippets and aggregators (dierenkliniek.nl directory, petla.app, openingstijden.nl, job sites) were used only to discover URLs, never as data. 24 h marked only where an opened page says 24 uur / 24/7 / 00-24 / dag en nacht. 24-h clinics (14): Spoedkliniek Midden-Nederland Utrecht (weekday nights 17-09, weekends 24/7), AniCura MCD Amsterdam, AniCura Haaglanden Rijswijk, AniCura Dordrecht, Evidensia Barendrecht, Geldrop, Waalwijk, Arnhem, Amstelveen (Amsterdam), Nieuwegein, Eelderwolde (Groningen), AniCura Tilburg (Berkel-Enschot), AniCura Oldenzaal (the last two and Zwolle rest on the 'Elke dag 00 - 24' spoed schedule), AniCura De Tweede Lijn Zwolle (18-08 weekdays + 24/7 weekends). Phone-only 24-h on-call, flagged in duty/note: AniCura Breda, AniCura Zeeuws-Vlaanderen (Terneuzen), Dierenartspraktijk Terschelling, Dierenartsenpraktijk Texel, Dierenartsen Dokkum (Schiermonnikoog). Not marked 24 h despite 24/7 wording: AniCura Maaspoort Den Bosch (meta description only), Velserbroek (meta only), Noordwijk (inconsistent page), AniCura Maastricht (page titled PERMANENT GESLOTEN yet meta says 24/7 - skipped entirely), SDU Utrecht (24/7 for vets only). The Evidensia 'Spoed' overview page claims all hospitals 7 days/24 h but also lists 'Spoed Overdag Mon-Fri 06:00-18:00'; only hospitals whose own page states 24/7 are marked. Duty rotas (3): AniCura Zeeuws-Vlaanderen weekend roster, AniCura Den Helder out-of-hours rota (MCD Amsterdam / 't Ossehoofd), AniCura Leeuwarden shared roster. The Netherlands has no national or chamber-run (KNMvD) public duty list that could be opened. Poison line (1): NVIC (030-274 88 88) from a 2017 KNMvD infographic; no animal-specific owner line was found, the NVIC is a human centre that also advises vets; the RIVM page states vergiftigingen.info is professionals-only. Phone and owner access must be re-verified. News/parliament context (NOS, NH Nieuws, Kamervragen 2024Z09637): spoed care is shrinking; Evidensia Den Haag night service was closed (owners sent to Amsterdam or Barendrecht), so Den Haag has no 24-h clinic of its own - Rijswijk is the nearest (AniCura Haaglanden). NH Nieuws 2021 (West-Friesland night rota Bovenkarspel/Zwaag/Enkhuizen) is outdated and not included. Not reachable / not obtained: evidensia.nl root (provenance), AniCura Hilversum contact page (client error), dierenartsentexel.nl (not fetchable), vvvameland.nl dierenwelzijn page (not fetchable), own clinic sites for Nijmegen, Maastricht (AniCura closed), Enschede, Amersfoort, Haarlem-based practices other than DierenDokters, Zandvoort (no clinic in town found; Bloemendaal/Velserbroek/Noordwijk are the nearest), Vlieland (vlieland.net search found no vet page), Ameland (vet listing not opened), Schiermonnikoog (no island practice, see Dokkum). Cats: De Kattenkliniek van Groningen (Van Lenneplaan 15, 050-8531899) and Dierenkliniek de Ark Oost-Souburg, Dierenkliniek Almeloord Almelo, Dierenziekenhuis Assen (Pelikaanstraat 2) appear in a third-party directory as 24/7 but their own sites were not found, so none were added. Left for follow-up: own-site research for Nijmegen, Maastricht, Enschede, Almelo, Assen, Amersfoort, Ede, Zandvoort; Ameland and Vlieland vets; KNMvD regional duty lists; confirm NVIC number on a current official page; Evidensia Den Haag status; remaining AniCura locations (84 listed) and non-chain independent clinics.
